description: Create the Lead Search page with multi-source API integration (Google Places, SerpAPI, Apify, manual CSV), the CRM leads list page with filtering/sorting/pagination, the lead detail view page, and the CSV import page. Also create the deduplication logic.
steps: Create admin/lead-search.php with a search form containing fields: Business type/niche (text), City (text), State (text), Country (text), Search radius (number), Maximum leads to fetch (number, default 100), Source dropdown (Google Places API / SerpAPI / Apify / CSV), Minimum rating (number), Maximum rating (number), Has website (select: yes/no/any), Has phone (select: yes/no/any). On form submit, call the appropriate source function and display results with save option.

In functions.php, add searchGooglePlaces($params) function that uses cURL to call Google Places API nearby/textsearch endpoint with the configured API key from settings. Parse JSON response and normalize results into the standard lead fields array. Include proper error handling and rate limiting.
In functions.php, add searchSerpAPI($params) function that uses cURL to call SerpAPI Google Maps endpoint with configured API key. Parse response and normalize to standard lead fields.
In functions.php, add searchApify($params) function that uses cURL to call Apify actor API with configured token. Parse response and normalize to standard lead fields.

In functions.php, add deduplicateLead($leadData) function that checks for duplicates by: phone number match, website URL match, business_name + city match, source_id match (Google place_id). If duplicate found, update missing fields where new data is better (non-empty replaces empty). Return array with 'is_duplicate' boolean and 'lead_id' if existing.
In functions.php, add saveLead($leadData) function that calls deduplicateLead first, then either inserts new lead or updates existing. Returns result with action taken (inserted/updated/skipped).
In functions.php, add saveSearchLog($searchParams, $results) to log the search in lead_searches table with total_found, total_saved, total_duplicates.

Create admin/leads.php as the CRM list page with a data table showing: Business name, City, Category, Phone, Website, Rating, Reviews, Audit score, Opportunity level, Status, Last audited date, Actions (View, Audit, Mark Contacted, Delete). Add filter sidebar/section with: City filter, Business type filter, Audit score range, Status dropdown, Has website (yes/no), Has WhatsApp (yes/no), High opportunity only checkbox, Rating range, Review count range. Add pagination (25 per page). Add bulk select checkboxes.

Create admin/lead-view.php that shows full lead profile: business details section, contact details, website details, Google profile details, social links found, audit score with breakdown, problems found list, recommendations list, suggested Bharat SEO package, auto-generated WhatsApp outreach message, notes textarea with save, follow-up date picker, status update dropdown. Load audit data from lead_audits table if available.

Create admin/import-csv.php with file upload form accepting CSV. Parse CSV with columns: business_name, phone, website, google_maps_url, address, city, category, rating, reviews. Run each row through deduplicateLead/saveLead. Display import results summary (imported, duplicates, errors).
acceptance_criteria: All PHP files pass php -l syntax validation
admin/lead-search.php has a form with all specified input fields and source dropdown
functions.php contains searchGooglePlaces, searchSerpAPI, searchApify functions using cURL
functions.php contains deduplicateLead function checking phone, website_url, business_name+city, source_id
admin/leads.php displays leads table with all specified columns and has filter form
admin/lead-view.php shows complete lead profile with audit results, package recommendation, and outreach message
admin/import-csv.php handles file upload and CSV parsing with deduplication
All admin pages include requireLogin() check and CSRF protection on forms
verification: Verify admin/lead-search.php, admin/leads.php, admin/lead-view.php, admin/import-csv.php all exist
